sense.text:
Eleutherophobia is the fear of freedom: an abnormal dread of being free, or of being forced to take responsibility for one’s own actions, often ending in a desire to be controlled. Many of our brothers and sisters love America and this wicked society, Babylon the Great. They don’t want to see this kingdom fall. They are content, comfortable and conditioned, the Negro fashioned, formed and created in America, as Bishop Yawsop says. Even when the law passed on the plantation, many did not want to leave; they knew nothing else. Now that a little ease is given to move around the penitentiary yard, they are too comfortable.

The fear comes from the responsibility, the uncertainty and the decision-making that come with autonomy, and autonomy is self-government. True self-government is under God: independent to God’s laws, God ruling over us. That is the true sovereignty, coming up underneath the laws of God. Brothers say they’re good here, they’re sovereign, but there is no sovereignty until you understand who you are and come back to the laws of God. And it ends in self-sufficiency.

So the Lord commands: “Gather yourselves together.” God commands the so-called blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans to gather themselves together: in housing, gardening, education, banking, medicine, dentistry, phlebotomists, lawyers. We have to be self-sufficient. God’s laws force us to gather ourselves together, and that is what it means to be free. It does not mean gather with the other nations. God is very specific: you 12 must gather yourselves together. All we got is Israel.

“O nation not desired.” We are that nation. No nation likes us; they don’t care to deal with us, they mock us. Godfrey sat with Moab’s organized crime and was told: black people are the trendsetters, everybody copies you, your music, your style, but you have no unity, and you are very easy to break up. We can’t even organize crime. That is how jacked up a people we are, and these nations know they have oppressed us to the point that we are conditioned. You can jump, throw a football, sing and cook, but you can’t organize amongst yourselves.

That is why God told us to gather ourselves together. The only way is to come back to God’s laws and seek freedom through God’s laws, and the spirit of the Lord will be endowed upon you to make these moves. We cannot organize without the Father. It doesn’t matter how many marches or conferences take place; unless the spirit of the Lord is with you, there is no organization. What you see in IUIC is the development of an organized nation, with Christ Almighty as the head, under the laws and structures of the heavenly Father.

But the fearful prefer rigid routines and authoritarian control. That is America: you can’t worship the one true God here, you can’t gather yourselves together. They force division amongst our people and warp our minds to think we can do nothing without this demon as the authority over our lives. Our people beat each other up and are quick to pull a gun, but they are fearful of freedom and change. They prefer to be ruled over by their oppressors instead of a righteous Father.

“Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff”: before ultimate destruction comes here to America, nuclear warfare, Babylon the Great set on flames. In that day of persecution we must flee. We will be as pilgrims on this earth, so don’t get attached to the possessions you have here. That day comes where we can only lean on one another. We prefer to lean on our oppressors that don’t give a damn about us, and when all hell breaks loose they will put a lot of us to death. A lot of y’all that felt you had a choice or a chance with them, they’re going to slaughter and put y’all behinds to death too.

“Before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you”: the judgment of Christ, the judgment of our Father coming back. God is saying get your house in order before that day. If you disregard everything the Lord told you, if you disregard your freedom, if you disregard setting your house in order and building your nation back from the decayed estate, his wrath comes upon you. You forsook his law and hated his instruction, so fire is set before you and you will be burned and punished for it.

“Seek ye the Lord.” That is the problem with our people: they don’t want to seek the Lord. They would rather seek John Madden, Creflo Dollar, Nicki Minaj, Lil Wayne, Trippie Redd and a plethora of wicked Negro influencers. They prefer to seek the knowledge of this wicked world.
“I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.” Christ is not speaking to the entire planet. That world is the nation of Israel.

“When ye have lifted up the Son of man”: the Son of man is Christ, speaking about himself. “I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.” That cuts the unholy trinity doctrine.

“He that sent me is with me”: the Father. Christ is our God, and Christ says nothing different than what the heavenly Father says. Christ said he will never leave you nor forsake you, and in like manner the Father told Christ the same. They are not against each other; they are of the same spirit, in agreement. That again cuts the unholy trinity, which is a new thing upon the earth.

“The Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.” Our brothers and sisters don’t want to do anything that pleases the heavenly Father, not one law. But they will shuck and jive to please their boss and please the other nations. When it comes to the laws of God, they want nothing to do with them.

“Many believed on him”: many took heed to what Christ was saying. Then comes the stipulation: “If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed.” If you continue in my laws and apply my word, you are my students, my children indeed.

“And ye shall know the truth”: the truth of the whole reason Christ is on the earth dealing with us at this time. That truth is the gathering of the 12 tribes of the children of Israel. Christ is here to gather us back. That is not taught in the churches; our people love lies. The pastor is not telling you that the whole mission of Christ was to come and gather the 12, establish his government, and rule this entire planet with his sons. They tell you get it how you live, YOLO, get the bag.

Our people are not given the tools to understand what true freedom is. They fear freedom and they fear change, but they say they love Jesus with no clue. The truth of who you are shall make you free. “And the truth shall make you free”: those are the keys to freedom out of this wretched-ass captivity.

precepts.why:
The truth shall make you free, so how is that done? Let the Father speak. Christ is sent “To open the blind eyes”: this truth opens the eyes of the blind, those who walk around in darkness.

“To bring out the prisoners from the prison.” America is one gigantic institution. The 12 tribes of Israel all through the world, but mainly here in Babylon, are incarcerated in their sins, with shackles on their minds spiritually and on their bodies physically. Our people fill the jailhouses and they fill the churches, and the church is a morgue and a prison house: nothing but dead spirits and incarcerated individuals in there, through the generational curses of their grandmothers. We all came out of the church, and our brothers and sisters can repent, but they are institutionalized here in America. Trump is the warden of this prison; each president is the warden of this system, the modern-day Pharaoh.

“And them that sit in darkness out of the prison house”, because we are captives here in this land mass. “I am the Lord: that is my name.”

sense.text:
“But this is a people robbed and spoiled.” We are robbed of our nationality, robbed of the proper understanding that we are the 12 tribes of the children of Israel.

“They are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses.” The prison houses are the churches on every corner, the doctrines and philosophies of our oppressors, and the literal correctional facilities that the majority of our young black men and women inhabit.

“They are for a prey”: we are prey to these other nations that come upon us, spoil us, deceitfully use us and make tons of money off of us. We are hunted by them every day. “And none delivereth”: where are the esteemed of our men, the leaders in the black community? None of them speak up on our behalf unless there is a check involved. Nobody is coming to the rescue, and we have no seat amongst these nations.

“For a spoil, and none saith, Restore.” No other nation is saying let’s restore the 12 tribes of the children of Israel. They stole from Pookie and Ray Ray, did all types of experiments on us, stole cells like Henrietta Lacks, and there is no restoring. They don’t give a damn about us; they could give a damn if we die, dead on the corner, and they’ll pass us by. To them we are no more than a deer carcass on the side of the road. They don’t want to restore us, because our restoration means they go into slavery and must give back everything they spoiled from the children of Israel.

precepts.why:
How are we spoiled as a people, and what is coming for it? “Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured”: that will take place upon the oppressors of our people. “And all thine adversaries”: all the nations outside the children of Israel. “Every one of them, shall go into captivity.”

“And they that spoil thee”: through a multitude of captivities, every single nation has had its hand in the oppression of the 12 tribes. That includes the Arabs that many brothers and sisters cry over in Palestine: those people had your people oppressed too, spoiling the hell out of us. What you see overseas right now is the righteous judgment of the Lord, prophecy fulfilling.

And yet brothers and sisters are so fearful to escape this captivity and get themselves together, even as the prophecies come to pass, even those sitting in the congregation. Many are called but few are chosen, so examine yourself. With bombs dropping and rumors of war, brothers are committing fornication, letting their wives rule over them and dictate where they fellowship, hiding the folly of their wives. Y’all some weak men. You sit there catting around, letting a woman run your ass, paying for prostitutes, so hooked up and controlled by marijuana you can’t even stay sober, controlled by the porn system. Bombs is dropping, and you over here wanting a release. Our people are sick; they are afraid of freedom because sin controls them.

“They that spoil thee shall be a spoil”: in turn they will be a spoil for us. The tables are turned, because we serve a just God.

None saith restore, so who restores? “Sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving”, the Lord who covers the heaven with clouds, prepares the rain, gives the beast his food, and “taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.” Then from the top: “Praise ye the Lord: for it is good to sing praises unto our God”.

“The Lord doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel”: the 12 tribes. Christ is coming to restore this glorious nation. We are not worried about these other nations restoring us, though many of our brothers and sisters feel that is the only way we will come together. These other nations don’t give a damn about us. Christ is the one that shall come, restore and bring back the outcasts of the children of Israel.

“He healeth the broken in heart”: we are the ones broken in mind and spirit, for the heart is the mind. “And bindeth up their wounds”: everything we went through in captivity, it is the Lord that will minister the ointment to heal his nation. These other nations cannot fix you with their philosophies and doctrines.

Many brothers and sisters seek peace and can’t stand to see the war in Iran or wherever America has its hand. Even remembering fuel at a dollar eighteen a gallon and wishing for those days again means wanting America to continue on. This affliction has to happen. Gas is near seven, eight, ten dollars a gallon, and that is prophecy coming to pass, the proof before your eyes. Stop complaining at what you see, because when we see these things our salvation draws near. These things must come for our people to seek the Lord.

sense.text:
“The disciples came unto him privately.” In John 8 Christ said if you continue in my word you are my disciples indeed and the truth shall make you free. The disciples are back on the earth today, the men of the prophets. This Bible is a great mystery and it was given only to them, and they are living what is being read.

“What shall be the sign of thy coming”: the sign of Christ coming back. “And of the end of the world”: not the entire planet blowing up, but the end of the rule of Esau. The fuel prices and the bombs our brothers and sisters fear to see are these prophecies being fulfilled, the ushering in of Jacob’s trouble. The redemption draweth near and the way home is coming to pass quickly.

“Take heed that no man deceive you.” Think on the ways our brothers and sisters are deceived every day. In this age it is AI, and much of it will be used against the prophets. We are deceived with false doctrines and religions, into worshipping a white image that does not fit the scriptures, into walking around a goddamn rock, and by pastors saying all can be saved and God loves everybody. We are deceived with unhealthy food portrayed as clean. We are deceived in many ways to break God’s laws.

“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars.” Brothers and sisters think this is still to come. Since World War I the United States has been in World War II (1941 to 1945), the Korean War (1950 to 1953), the Vietnam War (1961 to 1975), the Persian Gulf War (1990 to 1991), Afghanistan (2001 to 2021) and Iraq (2003 to 2011), plus Cold War operations, the Balkans, and interventions in the Middle East and Africa. It all kicked off in 1917, and here in 2026 it is still wars and rumours of wars. These are birthing pains, and brothers see them and fall right back to sleep. As Deacon Malachi says, don’t watch the news here; watch Al Jazeera, news from outside the United States, so you can follow the scriptures and the timeline.

Now we are back in Iraq, and Iraq is making America look crazy. These dragons of Arabia will reunite; they are seeing that America is not as big and bad as it thinks. America has always had its hand in oppressing, destroying and bombing other nations, and these nations see the cracks in its armor. But it is Christ that is going to bring this nation down.

“See that ye be not troubled”: that is the main part. You are troubled and fearful of freedom, troubled and fearful of your salvation. “For all these things must come to pass”: so what are you fearful of? Brothers and sisters should be celebrating, partying like it is a new moon every day when the news shows the conflicts between your enemies. We offended our Lord and went into captivity, but knowing these prophecies there is nothing to complain about. Deacon Obadiah said he doesn’t think America has 15 to 20 years left. Now is not the time to play with your salvation. Those who are troubled are the ones catting around with secret sin; you would have no trouble if you really believed this truth.

Every bomb dropped and every war fought loosens the grip of the shackles of our captivity, breaking every spiritual link tied around the mind of our people, because your salvation is at hand. Thank the Lord for every bomb and every crater; it is shaking up this earth and ushering in the King of kings. Don’t be fearful when you see flames and refineries blowing up. The Lord is the director of this thing and we are all playing our part.

“But the end is not yet”: we are only seeing the beginning of the birthing pains.

“For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom”: it has been going on since the World War and beyond, and in 2026 nations are still rising against nations: the theft of oil, Venezuela robbed of its crude, America bombing nations, sanctions, missiles.

“And there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places”: all of that right now. Droughts, famine in food prices, famine in oil, oil going to $200 a barrel. Twenty dollars used to get you around town for the week; now you can’t get up the street.
“All these are the beginning of sorrows.” It is just getting started. These are the catalyst of the sorrows that will come upon our people and the entire planet.

“Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted.” That is the nitty-gritty, the reason brothers and sisters are fearful of freedom. They would rather be the donkey and a turncoat to these other nations than be leaders of the 12 tribes, an example, a carbon copy of Christ, carrying the cross and facing death. They think the white man will pardon them for wearing a Make America Great hat. America ain’t never been damn great. I don’t give a damn how much money they give your ass, they’ll still put you to death. America does not like you. The white man can’t stand a traitor; he’s going to put your ass to death. They are users, they speak with a forked tongue, they are the sons of the devil, and devil means deceiver.

Brothers and sisters think the phone bill, the car note, the mortgage, not finding the food they want, getting up at 3 or 5 in the morning to work, a flat tire on the side of the road, is the Lord whooping them and their trials. You have not seen any sorrows yet. You have not seen Jacob’s trouble yet.

“And shall kill you”: we are going to be put to death for this truth, for honoring our King, applying the laws of God, staying steadfast in the Lord’s word and building this mighty nation, for keeping the commandments and going against this hell of a nation.

“And ye shall be hated of all nations”: it is happening now. We are number three on the terrorist list, above the Ku Klux Klan, though we have never killed or lynched anybody, never stole the Western Hemisphere, never bombed anybody’s land, never burned crosses or fed babies to alligators. All nations that have their hand in the destruction of the 12 hate us.

“For my name’s sake”: for the truth of Christ, because we speak the testimony of Christ. We tell our people Christ is a black man according to the scriptures, and Christ came only for the 12 tribes of Israel. Now a white nationalist says black people have done a disservice in the church and need to be reconditioned, to come back and learn from white people. They know the prophets are back on the earth teaching our people who they are by nationality in the Bible. They know the awakening is happening, they know their time is up, and they cannot stop this truth.

“And then shall many be offended”: many brothers and sisters within the body. “And shall betray one another.” A lot in the congregation are not here for the right reasons. There are opportunists, fearful of freedom, here only to make a quick buck. There are brothers and sisters sent by the three-letter boys, the FBI and the CIA, to spy out our liberty: a lot of Judas, as in Judas and the Black Messiah. But you can’t stop this truth. There are no guns here, no pimping of women, no drugs. We teach the word of God, and that is our weapon of mass destruction. The age of decadence is happening now, and it is spiritual.

Are you one of the many that shall be offended when correction comes? When the men are told to get their homes in order, and the women to be a pillar of rest and not stress, with their mind according to their husband’s mind and his according to the Lord’s? Or will you be bitter, and harden your neck under correction?

precepts.why:
“All these things must come to pass” because it was already ordained to happen this way. This Bible is a great mystery given to the sons of the living God.

“Declaring the end from the beginning”: God declared the end from the creation of the earth. There was already a council between us and our heavenly Father, and all of us agreed to take our roles as the 12 tribes of the children of Israel. “And from ancient times”: there is no time with God; he is beyond time. God declared the end of the white man’s captivity and our rulership from the beginning. He gave us the playbook before time was created.

“The things that are not yet done”: we are walking and living through the timeline of prophecy, things unfolding that were declared from ancient times, and brothers and sisters read it and still don’t believe what is coming to pass before their eyes.

“My counsel shall stand”: God’s counsel and will shall be done. You cannot move it, thwart it or throw it off track. Whether you believe or not, prophecy will be fulfilled; the word of the Lord will not go out void.

“And I will do all my pleasure.” This declaration made before time is pleasurable in the sight of the Lord. But brothers and sisters don’t see it as pleasure; they are fearful of the pleasures of the Lord. You have a phobia, fearful of freedom. You love sin and the wiles of the devil; it is your pleasure to be viewed as the refuse of the earth. Dress it up in a three-piece suit and the sharpest line-up, and in the sight of God you are like crap, because you prefer sin over righteousness.

So back in Matthew 24:6: “for all these things must come to pass”. The will and the pleasures of the Father will come to pass.

sense.text:
Those sent among us to spy will only learn to repent. When it comes down to the bottom line, they want to know the secret sauce, and it is always God’s commandments. You won’t find us making maps, plotting, trying to take over buildings or doing anything malicious. You will find righteousness.

“By the word of truth, by the power of God”: that is how we roll. God’s laws, statutes and commandments are the secret sauce. “By the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left”: no matter where we turn, that is our MO.

“By honour and dishonour”: some honor the works, the platforms and the doors of opportunity that open up, and some perceive it as dishonor. “By evil report and good report”: some give evil report, but it is good report, because our intentions are pure. We are about big family energy: family, raising our children, taking care of our wives, the laws of God.

“As deceivers, and yet true”: those who are unbelieving, who hate God, hate Christ and hate the keeping of God’s commandments and statutes for the betterment of his people, see us as deceivers. But Paul said we are true. Our word is true.

“As unknown, and yet well known”: they act like they know nothing about the purple and gold, and label us black Hebrew extremists, but they know exactly that we are the sons of the living God.

“As dying, and, behold, we live”: they say we have no life, keeping the Sabbath, not cooking on the Sabbath. But we have life, because Christ, the Son of God, is in us. We have more fun than they could imagine. We keep more feast days than their wicked holidays, we make time for our families and wives, and we live our lives righteously, applying God’s laws to them.

“As chastened, and not killed”: as Christ said, though it may seem a man dies, yet he shall live.
“As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich.” They like to think the life we live is miserable. It is not: we are fulfilling God’s prophecy.

precepts.why:
Why we are rich: “Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world”. How are we poor? Because these nations defamed us and robbed us. We were robbed of our nationality and robbed of our land. Israel is your land, black man and black woman, Latino man and woman, Native American man and woman. We were poor in faith, not knowing our nationality or our history, but that stops now. Now we know.

“Rich in faith”: we are rich because Christ came for us. That is our faith. We keep the commandments and the faith of Jesus Christ, and we are rich in faith because the hope of deliverance is coming our way. We are the sons of the living God, and that is a blessing.

sense.text:
“Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God.” It is your job to look diligently: to assess yourself, keep up with current events, and study, apply and read your Bible, your four chapters a day. This Bible is a road map. We are not drawing anything up ourselves; the Lord has already given us the mysteries, and it is for us to apply them and activate the angels so these mysteries come to pass.

How do you fail of the grace of God? The world and the love of the things in it become your god and your vice. Your job becomes your god. You have no time for the Lord. You don’t know how to conduct yourself or be cordial, or how to accept correction when your brother or sister brings you the words of God, not their own. You get offended, and bitterness follows. A man can travel with another for years, damn near his number two, helping get the work done, then turn and hate him; it happened to one of our fellow captains. That is evil. The root of bitterness springs up in you because correction comes.

“And thereby many be defiled”: that root of bitterness is the catalyst for many brothers and sisters to be defiled. They go back into all forms of evil, wickedness and doctrine, fearful of being free from this wicked society, its teachings, philosophies and holidays. They go right back to it because they are comfortable, comfortable being the hair on Esau’s ass, receiving whatever comes out the back end of that demon. Like John Witherspoon said, I take a dog and kick his head in, that’s my pleasure. They are coons, literally.

“Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau.” We generally use this to show Esau is profane, which they are. But God likens the spirit of bitterness amongst our own brothers and sisters to the spirit of Esau. You are now a fornicator against the Lord and against his laws, and fornicating out in the world physically, an adulterer.

Profane is relating or devoted to that which is not sacred, not set apart or biblical: secular rather than religious, unhallowed, worldly. Worldly is being concerned with material values or ordinary life rather than a spiritual existence. That is Esau: steal, steal, steal, rob, rob, rob, and never enough. You have become profane and worldly just like that man, unholy, and your possessions are your god. You are worse than Esau, and Satan has now become your daddy. Esau was wicked and estranged from the womb, and when he wanted to marry he went to the Canaanitish women.

“Who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.” Your trinkets in this world are just a morsel of meat. You would rather give up your birthright than receive the kingdom of heaven. It is like the betrayer in The Matrix with his steak: he knows the steak doesn’t exist, and after nine years he decides ignorance is bliss. That is the sister who says I could just go back, the born-again vagina Bishop brought out years ago, and the brother glad to go back for one puff of the blunt. I’ve been with y’all nine years, I could go back and dabble with my sin. Then you become a betrayer and an offender of the word, for a short-lived pleasure.

“For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected”. Esau was never going to get the blessing; God had already chosen our father.

“For he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.” That is going to be a lot of you bitter-ass brothers and sisters in that day: I was on flyer missions, I was at the fundraisers, I traveled with the captains. But you had a bitter spirit, and Christ will say get away from me, I never knew thee. Death and destruction to your ass. Check that bitter spirit. If you have an issue with leadership, you don’t really have an issue with leadership: you are bitter towards the Lord.

precepts.why:
The root of bitterness goes back to this: “He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck”. That is the mindset of a lot of our brothers and sisters. They never took the scriptures seriously. Leadership corrects them, and corrects them, until the correction is null and void because they will not apply anything.

After a while the Lord says this spirit is rebellious; he hardens his mind and doesn’t care what you say. He don’t trust you. You harden your heart from always having correction done to you, until bitterness forms, and then you are out the door with your wife and your children.

The neck is the mind. You can’t tell that brother anything: I’m a man, you’re a man, I do what I want. Then do what you want, and burn by yourself.

This is how we end up esteeming the brothers and sisters that are without the body: they are choked and offended. Paul compares them to Edom, who was profane, with “any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau”. He compares the wicked of our people to Esau.

“Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.” That wicked man is Satan, the daddy of the wicked of our people and of Esau. Satan becomes your daddy. So we encourage our people not to be worldly, not to keep the customs of Edom, the I do me, but to come back home to their people.

“When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.” As Christ said, if you have aught against your brother, go to him; don’t think you can come to the Lord with matters unsettled between you and your brother, sister and people. Leave your gift at the altar. Your prayers become sin because you are not dealing right. In 2018 there were extortioners speaking against leadership. You are not to rise up against the hoary head; you are to honor and not revile the gods, your leaders. There was much disrespect and dishonor.

“Let his days be few; and let another take his office.” “Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.” That is what happens when Satan becomes your daddy. Repent.

sense.text:
Many brothers and sisters don’t like the council: you can’t tell me what to do, you think you’re holier than thou. Let’s see what God says.

“Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven”. Christ is speaking to the 12. Whatever the judgment is here on earth is bound in heaven. Christ is not coming down to speak to you and hand out the judgment; you already have the council here, and what leadership gives you is the words of God. Christ agrees with that, because, as Isaiah 46:10 declared, the end was declared from the beginning. Even Captain Tazwell walking up to this leadership table was declared before time existed. Your coming to the council you now want to go against was ordained from time before.

“And whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.” Loose means whatever we forgive on earth is forgiven with the Father and with Christ.

Brothers and sisters say leadership is just being mean. What does leadership have to gain from seeing you jacked up? We will be judged for it. All we gave you was the word of God. Either you take it and forbear, or you go out there and get burnt. That is your decision. Our job is to give you the laws. But many fail: they are fearful and hate freedom. They don’t want to be free from sin. They love this captivity.

precepts.why:
It is not just us saying it. The Lord already ordained you to come up here. Divine intervention is happening now: I am sending my prophets to tell you exactly what will fix your ailment and your sickness, and you cast it aside. I’m grown; who makes you lord over me?

“The preparations of the heart in man”: the preparing of your mind. You may get up saying you will rise at nine today, and the Lord says no, you will rise at ten, get out on the left side and stub your toe. You set the alarm to the T all week, a light sleeper, and that day it doesn’t ring, because that was the Lord’s doing. The Lord seals man’s instruction in his sleep.

“And the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.” The Lord dictates what you will even say back. The Lord may send a spirit down on you to go contrary to the doctrine and contrary to what leadership says in council, and you don’t even catch that it is a spirit speaking through you. It is also a learning experience to catch yourself. But many brothers and sisters cannot shake that legion and ride the wave until they are on the bitterness boat and outside the congregation, making three- and four-part emotional videos and complaining on Clubhouse about being unjustly done. Then the Lord blinds your mind, you are reprobate, and only the Lord can bring you back if he chooses. You are in the hospital rejecting all the medicine, the administering of the laws of God to get you right.

Our people hate their freedom. They are fearful of freedom, fearful of responsibility, fearful of leadership.

sense.text:
Brothers and sisters let their children go into the military knowing what is coming to America, even telling their sons it will be good for them. That is the devil on you, and you hate your child: if it pops off, they will be fighting against Christ. Brothers go into the military for a white woman, a Hellcat and a little trinket, and the new contracts aren’t what the military used to get; you go in to be a target. The purple and gold is the ultimate military: the laws and the prophets of God, full of leaders, prophets and gods. Why send your child to die for these white demons who will never send their own children to die? You think peace will come and America will go back to the old ways. To hell with America and the old ways, those old ways oppressed you. You think enlisting in this war will bring peace to the homestead, so see what actually brings peace.

“Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace”: the Lord will keep him and her in perfect peace. “Whose mind is stayed on thee”: whose mind and heart. That is your four chapters a day. That is not separating yourself, having godly conversation consistently, as in Malachi, where they thought upon the Lord’s name and a book of remembrance was written. That is making sure the sick in the congregations are well taken care of, traveling, you men doing the blitz, getting out of that black shirt and getting out here to teach your people: men of valor, soldiers of the Lord, putting in your brick.

Then the news, the destruction and the chaos won’t worry you. You will have a Coke-bottle smile from one ear to the next, because you know the mysteries and you are not fearful of freedom. You are established on the laws of God; they are your meditation and your chief joy. You don’t care what’s on the radio or the internet unless it is funneled through the Bible to keep up with the times. Our mindset must always be on the wisdom, the knowledge and the counsel of God.

“Because he trusteth in thee”: that is the key. You trust in the Lord and in his words, and you build yourself up. You trust the Lord, and pray and weary the Father for that perfect peace in wanting to see the destruction of these nations, because you trust the word of God that he shall deliver the 12 tribes of the children of Israel.

precepts.why:
“But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith”. It is the job of the leaders to build the man, but once you have the foundation, it is for you to take the notes from the classes, apply them to yourself and add to them. Do a serious checkup from the neck up. Take a dry-erase marker to your mirror and write your issues with the scriptures next to them, and at the top write execute: those are your orders for the day, to kill the thing you are dealing with. If you don’t see it, you will never fix it.

Brothers and sisters don’t write anything down. Shalom, notes done, Bible closed for the rest of the week, and then they are stressing, when the fix for what they dealt with last week and will face this week came out in the class. We don’t examine ourselves. Don’t ask the captain what he sees in you; what do you see in you? Leadership has the blessing of discernment, but it only goes so far; we can’t see all the deep recesses of what you are dealing with. You have to go before the Lord, confess it, and ask him in sincerity to remove those things from you.

The spirits on those who could care less can rub off on leadership. Many brothers and sisters are spiritual vampires, and it takes a toll on leaders because we love our people. So be fervent, everyone in the room and everyone online. God has this hospital set up for you to get help, and for you to be a minister of the medicine, which is the laws. With a headache you don’t throw the Tylenol in the trash; you take it. So why throw away the medicine for your soul and your salvation? Why be fearful of freedom?

“Praying in the Holy Ghost, Keep yourselves in the love of God”: not in the crosshairs of his anger and rage, not in his wrath. “Looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ”. It is our job to keep ourselves in the love of God. I can’t save you and you can’t save me. The Lord said it won’t be easy; you have to go through this fiery trial to get the kingdom. Do your part. You have the keys to freedom.

How do we obtain that peace? The young men who enlist think they will bring forth peace, but they are only signing their death certificate faster. They go in for the benefits, not understanding they are about to receive the biggest benefit and reward they could ever imagine: a body that can’t faint, wings, leaping over buildings, like King David.

“So of thy people”: the Israelites. “Was accepted both the salvation of the righteous, and destruction of the enemies.” But our people say Becky must come with me, I have to save the strangers, she comes with the package, like the new Dodge Durango.

You have to accept the destruction of your enemies and the fall of these oppressive nations. That is your salvation. Two-step every time you see a bomb drop; that should be the mentality. Accept the destruction of these nations and don’t hold on to them. Accept the freedom at hand and don’t be fearful of it, because other nations had to be put to death for you. The Most High destroying them is his pleasure, and it should be yours.

This is a spiritual war. We don’t need to pick anything up. Let the Lord fight. He is the ultimate chess player; Bobby Fischer was nothing beside the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Sit back, grab your popcorn and enjoy the ride.

sense.text:
See the flip side: the desire to escape slavery was once classified as a mental illness, called drapetomania. The white man deemed it a mental illness for us to leave the plantation and seek freedom and refuge from oppression. Not even a dog wants to be beaten; he will run away. But being beaten and worked from sunup to sundown, wanting to get our family out of that oppressive state was called a disease. That is the mindset of your oppressors, and they did a hell of a job, to the point that men now have a mental illness and a spiritual disease and are fearful of freedom. Esau has put such a whammy on us that we are afraid to usher in our freedom, and would rather serve these demons and pray America is made great again than be changed in the twinkling of an eye.

Now the white nationalist Joel Webbond says 92 to 95% of the black church is heretical, that there are not enough black men who know enough theology to pastor, and that the black church needs to be split up and go find a good white church. Come home to master, come learn from the white man, you are not fit to run anything in Christianity, you must be taught again. Nothing from his own church constitutes the church either. Either you are a disciple of righteousness, or you are a disciple and a slave to sin and this world.

“Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world”: your house, your car, the job, the sports world, entertainment, whatever tickles your fancy. God says you are not to love or conform to this world. We are pilgrims here on a mission: to wake up the 12, and to see the fall of our enemy and push to bring it forth. This is war.

“If any man love the world”: if you love your condition, your incarceration, this global prison, “the love of the Father is not in him.” You are content to sit and rot in this institution. The world is your god and your father; Satan is your father.

“For all that is in the world”: everything this world consists of. “The lust of the flesh”: in America everything is accessible. If you want it you can order it, and Amazon has it there in twenty minutes from Hong Kong.

“The lust of the eyes”: social media, looking at the big butt, sisters looking at the big feet, keeping up with the Joneses, twerking. A competition of who can jump on top of a car, twerk and kick in a bystander’s window, smoke the most weed, roll the biggest blunt, rap about nothing and can’t say their ABCs. Our people love the world for those things, but fail to love God.

“And the pride of life”, all of it “is not of the Father, but is of the world.”

“And the world passeth away”: Esau’s rulership is already slated and ordained to pass away. When the destruction comes, will you escape it, or pass away with Esau’s rulership? “And the lust thereof”: everything you could not see yourself living without will also come to an end.

“But he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever”: you will have everlasting life and rule over these kingdoms. You must hate this world and everything in it. Brothers, even the sight of a sister in pants should infuriate you, to the point you are trembling in your reins, though there is a time and a place. The YNs, the young nuisances, walking around with their pants should infuriate you. I would love to see brothers come together with belts and just beat ass all through the neighborhood, dads standing up on an ass-whooping spree. Bring back the belt. But we have a belt: the God of Israel is doing the ass whooping right now, and you will keep seeing it as long as our people love this kingdom of captivity.

precepts.why:
What is the pride of life? “The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God”. That is the pride of life read in 1 John: hating God and pulling yourself back from the love of the heavenly Father, preferring this world, this system and this setup over the guidelines of God. You would rather have this phobia and be guided by your oppressors.

Pride goes before destruction. When you go contrary to the Lord, death is at your door. “And his heart is turned away from his Maker”: his heart is removed from the one that created him.

sense.text:
“Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey”: that is the million-dollar question. Who do you give your service to? Who are you in allegiance with? Who do you reverence? Do you yield yourselves to money, to mammon, to the spirit of fornication, to alcoholism, to the big-mouthed black woman that sleeps right next to you, to weakness as a man, to fear? Do you believe Satan when he whispers that God can never use you because of your past? Christ himself says that when you come into this truth and apply it, you are a new creature; old things are passed away. To yield is to give passage: you yielded to sin.

“His servants ye are to whom ye obey”: you are a servant to whatever you obey, either on the righteous side or the side of the devil. Do you obey God’s laws, or side with sin? My opponent is not the brothers in here who look like me. It is the man in the mirror, and sin is my op. Young men, make sin your op. Use the clip on this Bible to shoot down all sin that opposes you and our Lord, and put your energy there.

“Whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?” Will you obey God and get the kingdom, or reap the wages of sin, which is death? Choose ye this day who is your Lord.

Many cannot function without an oppressor, because with freedom comes change and responsibility. You can’t function without welfare, food stamps and Section 8. Our people go through these things, but use them as a tool to get where you need to be: come together, gather, and create markets and farms for the nation of Israel. You can’t function without Esau telling you when to piss, defecate, breathe, drive or eat. You are fearful of freedom, running on the clock of this oppressor, instead of seeing what God gave you. The tools are here: this is the key to unlock the cage our people are in. Hence voting your oppressor and his demonic policies in.

“But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart”: from your mind, “that form of doctrine which was delivered you”, the testimony of Christ. Thank God you understand your mission. As Bishop Kanai said in a heavy class, you have your crown, and it is for you to keep it upon your head. It is already there and you are already ordained to get it; you are the one who erases yourself out of the book of life. Will you hold on? It is a waiting game.

precepts.why:
You have your crown, and we wear this verse on our backs. But brothers don’t consider what is on their backs; they commit sin with it on.

“Here is the patience of the saints”: that is a heavy word. The black man has no patience: I need it now, I can’t wait. That is what we just read concerning Esau; look at the attributes of your oppressors, and there is no patience in these nations.

“Here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” They patiently wait on the Messiah to fulfill his will, what was ordained before. They are not fearful of freedom. They know it is coming and they won’t give up. They won’t trade it for a couple of seasons to appease the flesh; they will ride this thing out for the long haul. They won’t come in, break bread, and then say to hell with it, because then the Lord will say to hell with you.

sense.text:
Brothers say they have to vote, that it is the only way we will get change, that they will vote their way out. No, you vote your way further down. Look at America today.

“Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the Lord thy God shall choose.” Israel sets a king over them only as the Lord chooses: the Lord gives the word to the prophets, and the prophets go to that person to set him king over the nation. That is right, but there is a key element in the verse before.

“When thou art come unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee”: this is the setup. We can only set someone over us when we are in our own land. Where are we today? In the land of our captivity. This is not our land. We don’t dictate the rules, statutes and commandments here; we have no say here.

And it must be one of our brethren that we set up. Is Donald Trump one of our brethren? No. That’s the devil the Bible speaks of, with a stinking ass, the damn offspring of Satan himself, and y’all voted him in. All the simple asses voting for Trump got sent right back to their damn countries; Latinos for Trump got kicked up out of here, and he didn’t give two damns about them. All of you who hate your own people voted for this demon, and he did nothing for you.

We are not to be out there voting. No man that wars entangles himself with the affairs of this life. Our war is spiritual; this is all carnal. Let it play itself out and shake the fear of freedom. The age of decadence is here. Let this place fall to the ground.

As Deacon Ithan said, we have to have racial anger, and as Wisdom of Solomon 18:7 showed, the enemy’s destruction is our salvation.

“Here is the patience of the saints”: this is what we are waiting for. “Here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” The scripture says we have to love the good and hate the evil. We are a love group: we love keeping God’s commandments and teaching them to our people and the world. But we despise evil.

Oppression makes a wise man mad. That is how we tap back in: realizing that this destruction is our salvation. So we wait patiently for the destruction of these nations.

precepts.why: What were the saints waiting for? “And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen”. Babylon is America, and it is fallen. “That great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: the death, the bodies, the souls, the slaves of our ancestors and of our people to this day. That is why Babylon falls, and that fall is what the saints are patiently waiting for.

“He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword.” Those that killed our people then, now, and in the future, when we are going to be slaughtered, must be killed with the sword.

And what is all of that? “Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.” Our patience and our faith is revenge. That is what we wait for.

sense.text:
We should be patiently waiting for the destruction of these nations. “The burden of Egypt.” Why is Isaiah referring back to Egypt, when Egypt’s captivity was before Isaiah’s time? Which Egypt is this? Revelation 11:8 shows it is spiritual Egypt: replace Egypt with America. The burden of America.

“Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt”: the swift cloud is a chariot. The Lord shall come with his chariots, many chariots, with his angels to bring wrath and destruction upon Egypt. “And the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence”.

“And the heart of Egypt”: the mindset, the doctrines, the mentality of the oppressive kingdom, “shall melt in the midst of it.”

“And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians”: militia against militia, civil war. There will be a feud here. Everything Trump is doing is causing an uproar. Your oppressors are getting ready; they are not with the government like you think. There is an uprising going on here as well as overseas.

“And they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” You see it taking place now. This place is divided. It may look like it is together, but these stars are falling and the stripes are broken.

precepts.why:
How do we know Isaiah’s Egypt is America? “And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt”. Spiritually. Is Sodom still around? No. Close by Ein Bokek in Israel, Sodom is destroyed: Sodom and Gomorrah, those five cities, are nothing; they are not there. So this is spiritual Sodom. It goes on even in the land of Israel among the Israelis today, but predominantly here in America, with men acting like women and women acting like men, committing things contrary to the laws of God. And it is spiritual Egypt.

“Where also our Lord was crucified.” How did they crucify Christ? His image and his message, and the message that you men are the greatest thing on the face of this earth. They deny it and say all people, God loves everybody.

“Their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city”: America is that great city, and our people are spiritually dead here. They are fearful of freedom; there is no spirit in our people to rebel with the laws of God.

“And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.” Is not America a great house? All nations are here, all manner of people. They try to make it look good, but Babylon is fallen; America is fallen, literally. They are not united like you think, and even their own movies, like Civil War, show it. But it is not for us to get intertwined. Let them fight it out; that has nothing to do with us.

“And if Satan rise up against himself”: who are the sons of Satan? Esau. Satan rising up against himself has nothing to do with you. We are the sons of the living God. That is not our fight. “And be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.”

That is the proof in the pudding. Look at the prophecy taking place right now: it is crumbling. Trump gives nations 48 to 72 hours to relinquish or be bombed, and moments later says they will figure it out. These nations are not stupid. But don’t sleep on this white man, don’t sleep on Esau. It is God that shall take them down, and they are being revealed.

sense.text: “But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done”: the report came back of the miracles Christ had done for the nation. “Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.” The Pharisees came together against Christ, seeing the miracles he was doing.

“If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him”. We have the same thing now with camps online that keep speaking evil and trying to dig up dirt on IUIC, making up all types of defamation stories, because the minds of the people are being turned with the word of God. It is not us; it is the Lord working through IUIC. Keeping the commandments is the sauce, and they can’t stand it because they are not applying the commandments.

“And the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.” Why did they say that? Because they were more concerned with their status than with being faithful to the people and the truth. Esau set them up and gave them position. It is no different than the Black Caucus, the bourgeoisie of our people: they received position only because the white man allowed them to have it. They are comfortable in this condition. They are the same spirits that murmured against Moses.

precepts.why:
They love this society, and they will not speak up for the condition of our people unless a check is involved, and then it is a short speech: let us hold hands, four million dollars.

“We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely”. Israel said that to Moses after seeing all the prophecies come to pass and all the miracles of the heavenly Father: the killing of the firstborn, blood in the water, complete darkness, the mockery of all the gods of Egypt in each curse, the sea split. They got into the wilderness and said that.

During the time of Egypt we dwelt in Goshen and left Goshen to work in Egypt, like living on the outskirts of Atlanta with all the money and Pharaoh in the center. We watched the curses fall on the Egyptians from Goshen and heard the screams. Yet they remembered eating the fish freely, though the Egyptians beat their backs. They were keeping the ways of the Egyptians.

These are the complainers, and many are among us to this day. I used to get a Whopper at Burger King; I like McDonald’s, Chipotle, Chick-fil-A and Waffle House; why do we have to be on the run and make ourselves enemies of the white man? He gave me a job slinging fries out the window. We remember the fish, the supplies and the goods of our captivity, because we are too fearful to flee and seek freedom. Why do you think God had to send Moses? They were comfortable.

“The cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick”: they were reminiscing hard. “But now our soul is dried away”, because we are out here, not under bondage, not oppressed by a dictatorship. They want somebody to think for them and give them everything. Why can’t we have the EBT like before, Moses? Why can’t I sit on the couch and eat bonbons and get a check? That was their mentality, and these same spirits are back again. They are fearful of freedom and they love oppression.

We have to come out of that mind state. Men, understand your value and your worth: you are the sons of God. Sisters, understand you are the daughters of Sarah. Israel, 12 tribes.
